news.title: White House proposal to “dramatically weaken” US research, experts warn
news.summary_en: US higher education leaders are calling on Congress to reject a Trump administration proposal to hand political appointees control over federal grantmaking, potentially impacting $1.1 trillion in funding.
news.author: Polly Nash

news.title: UK unis must pivot towards partnerships as China market evolves
news.summary_en: UK universities must move beyond viewing China as a recruitment market and instead build deeper strategic partnerships if they are to remain competitive, delegates heard at the British Universities China Association's (BUCA) ninth annual conference.
news.author: Rongrong Walker

news.title: Every 10 international students generate £1m for UK economy
news.summary_en: International students represent a major economic benefit to the UK, generating billions during their time in the country, a new report has found.
news.author: Beth Kennedy

news.title: Erasmus+ to replace Turing and Taith as sector calls for best of both
news.summary_en: As the UK winds down Turing and Taith in favour of a more generously funded Erasmus+, stakeholders say the transition must preserve the former schemes' successes.
news.author: Polly Nash

news.title: Ruth Fenton, Stafford House Study Holidays
news.summary_en: This week, The PIE sat down with Ruth Fenton, founder and director of Stafford House Study Holidays. We spoke about building her business, the challenges facing young people and global policy shifts.
news.author: The PIE News team

news.title: US students’ study abroad appetite holds strong
news.summary_en: Two new surveys have found strong demand for study abroad among US students, even as global conflicts and financial barriers weigh heavily on decision-making.
news.author: Polly Nash

news.title: Survey highlights gaps in universities’ international recruitment strategies
news.summary_en: New research presented at the Explore UK Forum by student recruitment platform Cialfo, part of Manifest Global, highlights three gaps in how universities recruit internationally, based on survey findings shared at the event.
news.author: Diya Singh

news.title: Is Andy Burnham going to save UK higher ed?
news.summary_en: If Andy Burnham becomes Prime Minister, will he save UK higher education? That was one question at this year's BUILA conference, where panellists delivered a dose of realism.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: Modi meets with Australian higher ed as Flinders announces India campus
news.summary_en: Flinders University is set to open a campus in Bengaluru, India, Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has revealed during Narendra Modi's visit to the country.
news.author: Beth Kennedy
